error[ZBX-E0220]: the container is not running
  while  looking for the container web-1
  cause  the container web-1 is stopped: it exited with code 3
  name   web-1
  state  stopped
  fix    see the containers and their states:   zbx ps --all
         start it again, then exec into it:     zbx run -d --name web alpine -- sleep 1000
  more   zbx explain E0220
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0220.html
